name: TopoGym-v1
description: The pinned environment registry and benchmark splits of TopoGym: gridworld reinforcement-learning environments with certified topology for exploration research. One record per stable environment id, with its canonical generator configuration and the certified Betti numbers (in both door conventions) at the reference seed. Environments are deterministic up to seeds, end to end.
citeAs: @software{carlson2026topogym, author={Carlson, Jason}, title={TopoGym: Environments and Benchmarks for Topological Exploration in Reinforcement Learning}, year={2026}, version={0.2.0}, url={https://github.com/jcarlson212/TopoGym}}

distribution.description: One record per pinned environment id.

distribution.description: Benchmark split: Hold-out; reported once. 189 instances.

distribution.description: Benchmark split: Hyperparameter selection only; never eval or hold-out. 189 instances.

distribution.description: The TopoGym source: pip install topogym; import topogym registers every id below.

recordSet.name: environments
recordSet.description: The TopoGym-v1 registry: every stable environment id with certified topology.

field.name: reference_seed
field.description: Seed used for the certified values below; any seed regenerates deterministically.

field.name: horizon
field.description: Pre-determined episode length: the larger of the size floor and 3x the turn-aware optimal route.

field.name: optimal_actions
field.description: Fewest actions from start to goal counting turns; blank when the environment has no goal. Makes difficulty auditable.

field.name: betti_z2_sealed
field.description: Certified Betti numbers (doors count as walls).

recordSet.name: split/family-holdout-test
recordSet.description: The withheld families: concept transfer, reported separately. One record per instance; seeds come from the split's disjoint band and canonical_config reproduces the instance exactly.

field.name: aliases
field.description: Space-separated registry labels naming this exact world. Identical configurations are carried once so no world is weighted twice; the aliases keep the collapsed labels discoverable.

field.name: template_id
field.description: Registry id the instance is built from.

field.name: seed
field.description: Layout seed, drawn from this split's disjoint band.

field.name: placement_jitter
field.description: Cells of placement perturbation; keeps the family's arrangement while making every instance distinct.

field.name: canonical_config
field.description: Canonical configuration string: the reproduction key for this instance.

field.description: Fewest actions from start to goal counting turns; makes the split's difficulty distribution auditable.
